channels.description: App stores and plugin marketplaces where Katapull brands publish apps. They reach merchants who keep a non-Katapull shop or core system, and warehouse staff on phones and handhelds. Apps are documented for DeliveryMatch, Returnista, EffectConnect and Picqer, and partner-published Business Central apps exist for Transus. A web check in November 2026 found no app-store listing for Highbiza, Vendit or Logic4. Logic4's Android scanner app is not described as distributed through an app store.

channels.subChannelName: Shopify App Store and Shopify Store Connectors
channels.description: Katapull apps and connectors installed in Shopify stores. Shopify stays the system of record for products and orders, and the Katapull platforms work behind it.

deployedBricks.deploymentRole: EffectConnect Shopify plugin: syncs products, stock and orders between Shopify and marketplaces.

usedInProducts.description: EffectConnect reaches Shopify merchants through this channel.
Part of the connected chain behind a Shopify store (persona shpm).

deployedBricks.deploymentRole: DeliveryMatch Shopify app (listed as free, launched August 2019): delivery options, labels and tracking.
